name: The Lust Out of Time
source:
Imagine waking up one day with a headache and not remembering anything from the last month.

As soon as you walk into your office, you see your computer turned on and a pile of discs that you don't remember leaving there. When you start checking them, you find photos and videos of intimate encounters that you had no memory of.

You would ask yourself, “What is going on? How did all this happen? Why can't I remember anything?”

That's exactly what happened to Grace Anderson, and only you can help her solve this mystery.

Grace Anderson is a 48-year-old woman, happily married with one child.

She works in the linguistics department at Miskatonic University in New Arkham.

Not even in her wildest dreams had Grace imagined committing the acts she now sees on her computer screen.

As she tries to understand what has happened, she will discover a part of herself that had remained hidden,

until now.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060070/The_Lust_Out_of_Time/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
想象一下有一天，你醒来时感到头疼，却记不起上个月发生的任何事情。

当你走进办公室时，你会看到你的电脑打开了，还有一堆你不记得放在那里的光盘。当你开始检查它们时，你会发现你不记得的亲密接触的照片和视频。

你会问自己，“发生了什么事？这一切是怎么发生的？为什么我什么都不记得了？”

这正是发生在格蕾丝·安德森身上的事情，只有你能帮助她解开这个谜团。

格蕾丝·安德森 (Grace Anderson) 是一位48岁的女性，婚姻幸福，育有一子。

她在新阿卡姆密斯卡托尼克大学语言学系工作。

即使在她最疯狂的梦想中，格蕾丝也没有想象过会做出她现在在电脑屏幕上看到的行为。

当她试图了解发生了什么时，她会发现自己隐藏的一部分，

直到现在。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060070/The_Lust_Out_of_Time/]Steam[/url]]
